description: Returns the account's audit records, one per licensed access, each with its licence terms and on-chain attestation (Merkle root and inclusion proof once confirmed). Filter: event_type ('content_access', 'bulk_content_access' or 'compliance_report_generated'). At most 30 days per call. Read-only. Requires a buyer API key with the 'audit' scope, a buyer session, or the Opedd connector sign-in.
name: get_audit_events
title: Read your audit log
